reason: This is a cross-cutting planner feature change, not a local fix. It introduces vector index support and touches path building/selection, physical plan enumeration, costing, plan building, explain/show output, plan-to-pb, stats-usage collection, and planner properties, with supporting changes in expression, executor, DDL/index metadata, and mockstore. New index-access semantics in these central planner paths have high blast radius and are exactly the kind of change that can hide Blocker/High optimizer or runtime correctness issues.
